{"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1794726369662,"sessionID":"ses_e22048d11ffezT3ls7KLafPW7z","part":{"id":"prt_1de06d10f001sE6kbmJMMWTw4k","messageID":"msg_1de06b9c1001vZCh3d9dJ73Ilo","sessionID":"ses_e22048d11ffezT3ls7KLafPW7z","type":"reasoning","text":"**Analyzing Departmental Shifts**\n\nOkay, so I re-examined the output, and that fake lead, `e27`, really shook things up in Sales. Their suspect count went down from 11 to 10. That means all the departments (`Engineering=9, Finance=8, Legal=4, Research=8, Sales=10`), each holds 6 Day-1 canaries.\n\n\n**Refining Canary Distribution**\n\nI've been working on a new strategy for suspect distribution across the canaries. The goal is to maximize unique identification. My current approach involves placing all 39 suspects into two Day-2 canaries, ensuring that any two suspects from the same (department, Day1\\_bucket) are in different canaries and different variants on Day 2. This approach results in unique identification using only the Day1\\_bucket and Day2\\_bucket, or, better yet, the department and Day2\\_bucket!\n\n\n**Optimizing Canary Deployment**\n\nI'm now focusing on Day 3 and Day 4 canaries, aiming for 4-10 recipients per canary, which guarantees the fewest recipients. Day 2 deployments cover all 39 suspects with hard separation by Day 2 canaries. Crucially, if two employees share the same Day 1 bucket, Day 2 placements ensure if one leaks, the other is 100% eliminated, even without variant labels. This dramatically simplifies leak identification.\n\n\n","time":{"start":1794726351119,"end":1794726369651}}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794726492086,"sessionID":"ses_e22048d11ffezT3ls7KLafPW7z","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"CpLpTrzLzGa5gI3H","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import json\nimport math\nfrom collections import Counter, defaultdict\n\nSTATE_PATH = \"/tmp/opencode/state.json\"\n\ndef load_state():\n    with open(STATE_PATH, \"r\") as f:\n        return json.load(f)\n\ndef save_state(st):\n    with open(STATE_PATH, \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(st, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)\n\ndef compute_posteriors(st, lam_ah_inn=0.1316):\n    emps = [e[\"id\"] for e in st[\"employees\"]]\n    emp_info = {e[\"id\"]: e for e in st[\"employees\"]}\n    decoy = st.get(\"decoy\")\n    docs = st[\"documents\"] # doc_id -> {day, recipients, is_canary, assignment}\n    \n    alive = {e: (e != decoy) for e in emps}\n    log_ll = {e: 0.0 for e in emps}\n    \n    # 1. Surfaced leaks (100% DSL-invariant!)\n    for lk in st[\"leaks\"]:\n        doc_id = lk[\"doc_id\"]\n        var_shown = lk.get(\"variant\")\n        doc = docs[doc_id]\n        rec_set = set(doc[\"recipients\"])\n        for e in emps:\n            if e not in rec_set:\n                alive[e] = False\n            elif alive[e] and doc[\"is_canary\"] and var_shown is not None:\n                asgn = doc[\"assignment\"]\n                distinct_vars = set(asgn.values())\n                nv = len(distinct_vars)\n                if nv > 1:\n                    if asgn[e] == var_shown:\n                        log_ll[e] += math.log(0.95)\n                    else:\n                        log_ll[e] += math.log(0.05 / (nv - 1))\n                        \n    # 2. Access logs per closed day\n    closed_days = set(st[\"closed_log_days\"])\n    n_days = len(closed_days)\n    reg_cnt = Counter()\n    ah_cnt = Counter()\n    for lg in st[\"logs\"]:\n        if lg[\"day\"] in closed_days:\n            if lg[\"after_hours\"]:\n                ah_cnt[lg[\"employee\"]] += 1\n            else:\n                reg_cnt[lg[\"employee\"]] += 1\n                \n    if n_days > 0:\n        for e in emps:\n            if not alive[e]:\n                continue\n            r = reg_cnt[e]\n            a = ah_cnt[e]\n            # Mole: reg ~ Pois(0.7 * n_days), ah ~ Pois(0.3 * n_days)\n            # Innocent (non-decoy): reg ~ Pois(0.9 * n_days), ah ~ Pois(lam_ah_inn * n_days)\n            ll_m = -0.7 * n_days + r * math.log(0.7) - 0.3 * n_days + a * math.log(0.3)\n            ll_i = -0.9 * n_days + r * math.log(0.9) - lam_ah_inn * n_days + a * math.log(lam_ah_inn)\n            log_ll[e] += (ll_m - ll_i)\n            \n    # 3. Interviews (deduplicated by (day, employee, topic))\n    seen_int = set()\n    for iv in st[\"interviews\"]:\n        key = (iv[\"day\"], iv[\"employee\"], iv[\"topic\"])\n        if key in seen_int:\n            continue\n        seen_int.add(key)\n        e = iv[\"employee\"]\n        if not alive.get(e, False):\n            continue\n        if iv[\"evasive\"]:\n            log_ll[e] += math.log(0.24 / 0.20)\n        else:\n            log_ll[e] += math.log(0.76 / 0.80)\n            \n    cand = [e for e in emps if alive[e]]\n    mx = max(log_ll[e] for e in cand)\n    probs = {e: math.exp(log_ll[e] - mx) for e in cand}\n    Z = sum(probs.values())\n    probs = {e: probs[e] / Z for e in cand}\n    \n    ranked = sorted(cand, key=lambda e: -probs[e])\n    return ranked, probs, alive, reg_cnt, ah_cnt\n\ndef print_summary():\n    st = load_state()\n    ranked, probs, alive, reg_cnt, ah_cnt = compute_posteriors(st)\n    emp_info = {e[\"id\"]: e for e in st[\"employees\"]}\n    print(f\"=== Day {st['current_day']} | Alive suspects: {len(ranked)} | Closed log days: {len(st['closed_log_days'])} | Leaks: {len(st['leaks'])} ===\")\n    if st.get(\"decoy\"):\n        d = st[\"decoy\"]\n        print(f\"Decoy: {d} ({emp_info[d]['dept']} c{emp_info[d]['clearance']}) reg={reg_cnt[d]} ah={ah_cnt[d]}\")\n    for idx, e in enumerate(ranked[:15]):\n        inf = emp_info[e]\n        iv_e = [iv for iv in st[\"interviews\"] if iv[\"employee\"] == e]\n        ev_s = f\"{sum(x['evasive'] for x in iv_e)}/{len(iv_e)}\"\n        print(f\"{idx+1:2d}. {e} ({inf['dept']:11s} c{inf['clearance']}) P={probs[e]:.4f} | reg={reg_cnt[e]:2d} ah={ah_cnt[e]:2d} | ev={ev_s}\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    print_summary()\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/tracker.py","time":{"start":1794726492078,"end":1794726492085}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1de08f788001VKsNAcxDEt184g","sessionID":"ses_e22048d11ffezT3ls7KLafPW7z","messageID":"msg_1de0867bf001NJ87MyP14TXw2V"}}
